title: Timor-Leste Climate and Seasons
summary: A tropical monsoon climate with one wet season on the north coast and a longer, two-peak wet season in the south.
actions: North coast (Dili, Manatuto, Baucau): wet season December–April, dry May–November
South coast (Covalima, Manufahi, Viqueque): rains November–July with a second peak around May–June
Highlands (Aileu, Ermera, Ainaro): cooler, wetter, with more cloud and frost-free but cold nights
Plan planting by your zone, not the national calendar

sections.heading: Zones
sections.body: North coast has a short single wet season; the south is wetter with two peaks; the highlands are cooler and cloudier.

sections.heading: Planning
sections.body: Match crops and planting dates to your zone. Ask your extension office for local rainfall records.

title: El Niño and Late Rains
summary: El Niño years bring late, weak rains to Timor-Leste; prepare drought-tolerant crops and water storage.
actions: Listen for El Niño warnings on radio before the planting season
Plant drought-tolerant crops (cassava, sweet potato, sorghum, cowpea) alongside maize
Wait for the soil to be properly wet before planting maize; do not plant on the first shower
Keep extra seed in case a replant is needed

sections.heading: What happens
sections.body: Rains start late and stop early, and dry spells hit during maize flowering.

sections.heading: Prepare
sections.body: Diversify with drought-tolerant crops, store water, mulch and keep replant seed.

title: Humidity, Rain and Disease Risk
summary: Fungal diseases explode when leaves stay wet; use the forecast to time pruning, harvest and watering.
actions: Before heavy rain: harvest ripe fruit, check drainage, avoid nitrogen top-dressing
After rain: inspect lower leaves for spots within 2–3 days
In humid weeks: prune for airflow and water only at the base
Tomato and chili are most at risk; maize and beans are moderate; cassava is low

sections.heading: The link
sections.body: Most fungal diseases need 6+ hours of leaf wetness. Humidity above ~80% with rain is the danger zone.

sections.heading: Use the forecast
sections.body: Harvest and drain before rain; inspect and prune after.
